<?php
class ProducerBase205 { public static function zero() { echo self::class, "/", static::class, ";"; return null; } static function identity($saved) { echo self::class, "/", static::class, ";"; return $saved; } public static function first($saved, $ignored) { echo self::class, "/", static::class, ";"; return $saved; } }
class ProducerChild205 extends ProducerBase205 {}
class Base205 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
class Derived205 extends Base205 {}
$owner = new Derived205; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(ProducerChild205::zero(), ProducerChild205::first(true, 0)); unset($owner); echo ($child->saved[0] === null && $child->saved[1] === true) ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child);
$owner = new Derived205; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(ProducerChild205::identity(false), ProducerChild205::identity(7)); unset($owner); echo ($child->saved[0] === false && $child->saved[1] === 7) ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

class ProducerBase205 { public static function zero() { echo self::class, "/", static::class, ";"; return null; } static function identity($saved) { echo self::class, "/", static::class, ";"; return $saved; } public static function first($saved, $ignored) { echo self::class, "/", static::class, ";"; return $saved; } }
class ProducerChild205 extends ProducerBase205 {}
class Base205 { public static function __callStatic(string $name, array $arguments) { return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } }
class Derived205 extends Base205 {}
$prefix = "REQUEST"; $request = $prefix . "-NEW"; $child = Derived205::MiSsInG(ProducerChild205::identity($request), ProducerChild205::first(-0.0, 0)); echo ($child->saved[0] === "REQUEST-NEW" && (string)$child->saved[1] === "-0") ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class ProducerBase205 { public static function zero() { echo self::class, "/", static::class, ";"; return null; } static function identity($saved) { echo self::class, "/", static::class, ";"; return $saved; } public static function first($saved, $ignored) { echo self::class, "/", static::class, ";"; return $saved; } }
class ProducerChild205 extends ProducerBase205 {}
class Base205 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
class Derived205 extends Base205 {}
$owner = new Derived205; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(first:ProducerChild205::identity("BYTE\x80"), later:ProducerChild205::first(1.5, 0)); unset($owner); echo ($child->saved["first"] === "BYTE\x80" && $child->saved["later"] === 1.5) ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift205() { global $argument, $owner; $argument = new New205; $owner = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return null; }
class Old205 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } }
class New205 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class ProducerBase205 { public static function make($saved, $ignored) { echo "PRODUCER;", self::class, "/", static::class, ";"; return $saved; } }
class ProducerChild205 extends ProducerBase205 {}
class Base205 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $argument; $argument = null; echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
class Derived205 extends Base205 {}
$argument = new Old205; $owner = new Derived205; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(ProducerChild205::make($argument, shift205()), null); echo "RETURN;"; echo $child->saved[0] instanceof Old205 ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";
